value.rationale: Two-coloured permutation cycles are canonical integer realizations of Ewens(2); fixed-position recovery is natural. Spectral invertibility holds except a three-dimensional blind subspace at n=3, while positive definiteness has a nonmonotone re-entry across n=6,7,8. Sharp positive-spectrum condition numbers and finite limit e^4 solve an infinite-family operator-stability question, not arbitrary small enumeration.
